blurb: Guests receive various massage therapies such as traditional Thai massage using herbal oils and balms, oil/Swedish/deep tissue massage with customizable pressure, foot reflexology targeting reflex points on the feet, prenatal massage addressing sciatic nerve pain, and combination Thai massage blending body and oil massage. The massages aim to relieve stress, tension, and pain while improving circulation and relaxation. Communication with the therapist about pressure preference is encouraged.
